qualityPolicy: All 300 learner-facing Articles are substantial one-source adaptations with deterministic source, depth, study-support, ruby, vocabulary, grammar, and comprehension QA.
depthPolicy: Final Articles must pass level-specific substantial one-source floors: N5 >=350 Japanese characters/5 paragraphs; N4 >=450/5; N3 >=600/6; N2 >=800/6; N1 >=1000/7. These are minimum quality floors, never padding targets.
sourcePolicy: Default final method: one verified body-ready source produces one substantial Sakura learner adaptation. Do not stitch unrelated sources merely to manufacture length. Full verbatim reproduction is used only when the source registry specifically permits it and the record labels that mode honestly.

provenancePolicy.facts: 300 readings are grounded in linked official/open Japanese sources. The current source archive remains retained while learner bodies undergo the final depth rewrite.
provenancePolicy.learnerText: Learner adaptations are clearly identified and are not presented as verbatim government prose unless a record explicitly uses a permitted full-text mode.
provenancePolicy.attribution: Every record stores source title, publisher, URL, date, terms/license, attribution and edit notice.
provenancePolicy.assets: No source logos, photos, charts, videos, or separately credited third-party assets are included.
provenancePolicy.studyLevel: N5–N1 is Sakura study-support grading, not an official JLPT grade of the source.

sourceYearPolicy: 2026 first; if a category lacks suitable legally reusable 2026 material, use 2025, then 2024, then the newest verified legally reusable source available. Always display the actual source year.
packPolicy: Each level uses six 10-reading body shards plus a compact metadata index. Browsing/search reads indexes only; opening an Article loads only its required shard. The body cache remains bounded in memory.
